cues.text: Some journeys begin with a road.
And the hands you trust beside you.
Then choose what you will risk together.

voice.script:
Some journeys begin with a road.
Ours begins with a table.
With a hand that bargains.
A hand that gives.
And the hands you trust beside you.
A city of old debts.
A world of dangerous choices.
Close enough to touch.
Vast enough to lose yourself.
Real enough to matter.
Choose what you carry.
Choose what you spend.
Then choose what you will risk together.
One breath.
Two cards.
The room falls silent.
And the world answers.
Gloomhaven.
Gather your party.
The table calls.

global_video_prompt: Premium cinematic tabletop fantasy using the supplied exact GloomhavenVR render as the fixed design reference. Worn timber, restrained amber practical light, cool cyan or violet accents, rich detailed blacks, natural shallow depth of field, physically plausible materials. Keep the tabletop scale and the original mask, glove, armor, runes, artwork and board geometry intact. Camera motion is subtle and deliberate. Preserve the input composition and every visible silhouette. Text and logo will be composited afterward.
global_negative_prompt: No additional fingers or limbs, no full avatar bodies, no exposed human faces replacing masks, no changing mask shapes or painted runes, no new weapons, no first-person sword combat, no giant battlefield, no life-size miniatures, no melting card edges, no substituted card art, no generated text or logos, no sparks covering important contact, no modern sci-fi HUD, no aggressive camera orbit, no warping or temporal flicker.

shots.name: A world within reach
shots.motion: Start at miniature ground level in a gorgeous actual dungeon, seeming full scale. One slow move explores torchlit stone, then rises past the board edge to reveal the tabletop and original companion hands.
shots.prompt: Source-faithful Gloomhaven dungeon in warm torchlight, seen from miniature ground level with substantial stone and dramatic dark depth. Begin with an in-world impression; a deliberate gentle camera rise reveals the board edge and the tabletop surrounding it. Preserve exact environment and miniature scale. The second source plate shows the same world on its table with the actual three masks and shipped hands. No generic castle, new monsters or invented full avatar bodies.
shots.capture_reason: Source-locked dungeon presentation requires original native capture or an authorized read-only game-asset render; a table made from invented fantasy is not final.

shots.name: Small promises
shots.motion: Two restrained three-second inserts: physical merchant card handoff, then held purse reaching the priestess. Keep each resident's original offered-hand pose.
shots.prompt: Source-locked close insert of the actual merchant stand and original gloved hand offering an exact native item card, then a separate source-locked temple purse offering. Warm practical light; maintain original contact and silhouettes. Animate locally or use native footage; do not ask a model to invent fingers, cards or transaction outcomes.
shots.capture_reason: Item artwork, actual purse and native handoff timing need original capture or authorized read-only game assets.

shots.name: Companions
shots.motion: Three two-second portraits, a tiny camera slide across each mask's surface; no face/body additions.
shots.prompt: Exact source mask portraits: Ironwatch iron with aged brass trim; Runeveil pale face with existing violet markings; Grimhorn carved horned wood with existing painted markings. Render one mask per insert from original FBX and albedo. Bring its actual paired hand into the lower edge of frame. Preserve the original designs; light travel is more useful than invented motion.

shots.name: Old debts, dangerous choices
shots.motion: Three-second campaign-map detail dissolves into an original dungeon diorama detail; do not invent a city or monsters.
shots.prompt: Original Gloomhaven campaign-map geography, followed by a low camera sweep across the actual dungeon diorama. Warm torch accents and deep stone shadows; a cool accent may connect it to the rune mask. Keep board edges/miniature scale visible. Source capture owns all figure and terrain identity.
shots.capture_reason: Exact native campaign map and dungeon board presentation.

shots.name: Close enough
shots.motion: Macro on local glove carefully holding a real miniature, then ordinary idle release. Before the next native action, the figure must already be at its board position.
shots.prompt: Precise local-hand view of the actual leather glove holding an original miniature above its tabletop board. Exact five fingers and realistic gentle grip. Use original rig animation or native footage for contact, lift and release. Maintain the tabletop scale and original figure appearance. No generated grasp.
shots.capture_reason: Original miniature source and held/idle-release contact; no invented generic figure.

shots.name: The choice
shots.motion: Follow the original physical card to its exact offered pose. Original ring is in the card's plane; preserve hover/ring waveform if visible. Then study the local card fan while companions wait; preserve covered remote selection backs.
shots.prompt: The actual enchantress at her stand, an original ability card offered by the arcane glove. Existing violet/cyan cues and native offered-card ring only. Camera makes one restrained push. No new spell casting, no rewritten card front, no floating card that detaches from native pose. Capture or animate the exact interaction locally. Second insert: The controlled player's actual card fan in the foreground, original glove studying two choices. Companion plate and arcane hands wait around the table. Native scenario-selection privacy is intact: local cards are face-up, remote cards show exact native covered backs. Preserve native artwork and card geometry. Motion is original card handling, not generative morphing.
shots.capture_reason: Exact original offered card artwork, native hover, ring geometry and enhancement presentation.
shots.privacy: Map/town offered cards are public. In scenario ability selection, only the local controlled-character fronts may be exposed; remote cards stay covered. Omit visitor-local town pre-drop guides from observer angles.

cuts.subject: local native card fan and waiting companions

shots.name: Two cards
shots.motion: Local hands place the two exact ability cards in their original tray slots. Hold on second contact; no remote front disclosure.
shots.prompt: Tactile close-up from the local player's controlled-character perspective. Two actual ability cards settle into their original two play-tray slots with exact glove contact and original artwork. One simple action per beat. Use native footage or rigged local animation; no generated fingers or card text. Hold the composition as the room falls silent.
shots.capture_reason: Native original two-card selection/commit sequence and correct local-card identity.
shots.privacy: Local controlled cards remain face-up; remote selection cards remain covered.

shots.name: The world answers
shots.motion: Native miniature action begins from the board position. Low camera motion follows its short path; never start native movement from a held transform.
shots.prompt: Exact native Gloomhaven miniature turn inside its tabletop diorama. The miniature starts at the board position; all hands have released it. Actual native ability/action effect, presented faithfully. One camera sweep, preserved board scale and original character design. No unsupported player sword fight or invented explosion.
shots.capture_reason: Actual native action and figure movement rather than an invented gameplay claim.

shots.name: Gather your party
shots.motion: Return to the source-locked shared-table wide; a tiny rise reveals all three presences and preserves every board/card silhouette.
shots.prompt: Exact three-mask companion tableau around the same GloomhavenVR table. Ironwatch with plate hands, Runeveil with arcane hands, Grimhorn with leather-glove hands. Each presence has the two shipped hands; no avatar bodies. Preserve exact geometry and scale. A subtle ascending camera move and warm practical light bring the group into one composition. Hands settle rather than perform an invented action.
